$description: Portfolio design tokens, DTCG source of truth. Generated artifact is tokens.css (symlinked into the portfolio + case studies). Three tiers: primitives (hue+stop ramps) feed semantics (role), and component tokens (btn/card/chip/badge) alias semantics, never primitives. Faithful v1 transcription of the hand-written tokens.css; naming aliases + $type annotations layered in a later stage.

0.$description: Card surface; text on an accent fill.

150.$description: Half-step. accent-subtle on light; text-primary on dark.

700.$description: Text-secondary on light; strong border on dark.

850.$description: Half-step. Brand ink; accent on light; surface on dark.

950.$description: bg on dark; text-primary on light; accent-hover on light.

400.$description: Lime tint, one step under the brand value.

500.$description: Brand lime. The single canonical lime, the only stop consumed as identity (--brand-lime).

me.natemills.usage.role: The single canonical brand identity lime (--brand-lime).
me.natemills.usage.use: Brand identity only: primary button fill, brand outlines, focus rings on dark surfaces, the lime period and active dot.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Never as body text or links on a light background (composites to ~1.4:1, fails WCAG AA), and never as a theme-aware accent; the theme-aware role is color.accent, not this fixed identity value.
me.natemills.usage.decision: Fixed brand identity value (audit TK-05); other green stops are supporting tints, not identity.

550.$description: Saturated vivid lime; the highest-chroma stop (OKLCH chroma 0.229), sitting between 500 and 600 in lightness.

600.$description: Hover-dim lime, one step darker than brand identity; the target of --brand-lime-dim.

900.$description: Darkest usable lime, a near-black green.

lime-rgb.$description: Channel form of --brand-lime for decorative alpha shadows: rgb(var(--brand-lime-rgb) / 0.2). DERIVED by build.mjs from the referenced colour's hex anchor (audit TK-05), never hand-typed.

lime-dim.$description: Hover-dim step of the brand lime (green.600).

lime-vivid.$description: The hot vivid-yellow end of brand.gradient (#eeff00). Gradient stop only, never themed. Renamed from --brand-emphasis-2 (2026-07-02; the dangling -2 had no -1).

ink-rgb.$description: Channel form of --brand-ink for ink-at-alpha: rgb(var(--brand-ink-rgb) / 0.65). DERIVED by build.mjs from the referenced colour's hex anchor (audit TK-05).

gradient.$description: CSS-only composite; reads var(--brand-lime) and var(--brand-lime-vivid) so the gradient follows a brand re-point at CSS level (audit TK-05; DTCG forbids embedded aliases inside string values, review 2026-06-10). The explicit 'in oklab' preserves the perceptual midpoint the gradient had when its stops were oklch(): rgb()/hex stops interpolate in sRGB by default, which would shift the blend by up to 11/255 (sRGB emission switch, 2026-07-27).

anthropic-large.$description: Anthropic orange, 18px+ bold. EXTERNAL brand: a locked, theme-agnostic constant, never aliased into a semantic token, not part of our palette.

anthropic-body.$description: Anthropic orange, darker 12-14px variant for contrast. External brand: locked constant.

linkedin.$description: LinkedIn brand blue, the LinkedIn mark only. External brand: locked constant.

bupa-blue.$description: Bupa brand blue, Bupa case-study context only. External brand: locked constant.

bupa-blue-dark.$description: Bupa brand blue, darker variant. External brand: locked constant.

bupa-blue-subtle.$description: Bupa brand blue, subtle tint. External brand: locked constant.

glitch-magenta.$description: Decorative glitch effect only (footer wordmark). Not a palette colour, never themed.

glitch-cyan.$description: Decorative glitch effect only. Not a palette colour, never themed.

bg.$description: The page canvas. Brand off-white in light, near-black in dark.

surface.$description: The default card / panel surface. White card on the grey page in light (a genuine lift); the lighter near-black (#1c1c1f) in dark.

surface-sunken.$description: Recessed wells, insets, thumbnails, chips. A step below the card surface: light grey in light; the darker near-black (#141416) in dark.

surface-inverse.$description: Always-dark slab surface, theme-invariant near-black (#0a0a0b). The full-bleed testimonials section stays near-black in BOTH themes (the metrics band matches it via a local theme scope); never overridden per theme, like static-white in reverse.

me.natemills.usage.use: Full-bleed inverse bands that must stay near-black in BOTH themes, e.g. the testimonials section and the matching metrics band.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Do not use as a normal card or panel surface (that is color.surface), and never add a per-theme override; it is intentionally not theme-reactive, like static-white in reverse.
me.natemills.usage.decision: Theme-invariant by design: resolves to the darkest stop in every theme so the inverse band reads identically.

surface-inverse-sunken.$description: Inset on an inverse slab, theme-invariant near-black (#141416), the same dark value as surface-sunken. The testimonial portrait image-load fallback; never overridden per theme. Reads lighter than surface-inverse because neutral.950 is the darkest stop in the scale.

text-primary.$description: Default reading text. Near-black on light, near-white on dark.

text-secondary.$description: Secondary text: supporting copy one step quieter than text-primary.

text-tertiary.$description: Tertiary text: section labels and quiet meta copy; the last step that still clears 4.5:1 on light.

border.$description: Default hairline border and divider colour, theme-aware.

border-strong.$description: Heavier border for edges that must read past a hairline (secondary-button outlines).

border-brand.$description: The brand-lime outline accent (active selection, link underline, brand ring). Theme-invariant lime, never overridden per theme; the semantic the brand outlines read instead of the raw primitive.

border-hover.$description: Border colour on hover: ink on light, lime on dark.

accent.$description: The single theme-aware interactive role: ink on light, brand lime on dark. Active and selected states.

me.natemills.usage.role: The theme-aware accent role: ink (neutral.850) on light, brand lime on dark.
me.natemills.usage.use: Anywhere the accent should follow the theme, e.g. the active carousel dot and accent surfaces.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Do not assume this is lime or hardcode lime here; on the light page it is ink and only flips to lime on dark. For the fixed brand lime use brand.lime / green.500.

accent-hover.$description: Hover step of the accent role.

accent-subtle.$description: Quiet accent wash for subtle active or highlighted surfaces.

on-accent.$description: Text or icons sitting on an accent fill; the contrast pair of color.accent. Renamed from --color-accent-foreground (2026-07-02) to join the on-* family.

focus-ring.$description: Theme-aware keyboard-focus colour: ink on light, lime on dark. Consumed via border.focus.

me.natemills.usage.role: Theme-aware keyboard-focus colour: ink on light, lime on dark.
me.natemills.usage.use: The focus indicator colour, consumed via border.focus.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Do not hardcode a single colour and do not remove it without a replacement focus style; it must flip per theme to stay visible.

link.$description: Underlined navigational link text: ink on light, lime on dark. Distinct role from accent (Section 10).

on-ink-emphasis.$description: Solid-white emphasis step of the on-ink family (full white, above the 88% on-ink-primary); theme-invariant. Reserved for full-white emphasis on always-dark slabs; currently unconsumed outside the Under-the-Hood gallery (the hero headline moved to --color-text-primary with the 2026-06-25 editorial hero). Renamed from --color-hero-text-primary (2026-07-02; a component name squatting in the semantic namespace).

on-ink-primary.$description: Primary text on an always-dark slab (88% white).

me.natemills.usage.role: Primary text colour for content sitting on an always-dark slab (88% white).
me.natemills.usage.use: Headings and body text on an ink or dark band.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Never on a light surface; it is white-on-dark only and will vanish on a white card. For text on light use color.text-primary.

on-ink-secondary.$description: Secondary text on an always-dark slab (66% white).

me.natemills.usage.role: Secondary text colour for content on an always-dark slab (66% white).
me.natemills.usage.use: Muted or secondary copy on an ink or dark band.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Never on a light surface; white-on-dark only. For muted text on light use color.text-secondary.

on-ink-muted.$description: Muted NON-TEXT step of the on-ink family (40% white): inactive dots, quiet fills and pressed-state washes on an always-dark slab. Composites to 3.77:1 over color.surface-inverse, 3.83:1 over surface-inverse-sunken and 3.79:1 over brand-ink, so it clears the SC 1.4.11 3:1 non-text floor but fails the SC 1.4.3 4.5:1 small-text floor. Not a body-text colour, despite the on-ink family name.

me.natemills.usage.role: Muted NON-TEXT step of the on-ink family (40% white).
me.natemills.usage.use: Inactive dots, quiet fills and pressed-state washes on an ink or dark band.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Never as small body text: it composites to 3.77:1 over color.surface-inverse, below the 4.5:1 small-text floor. For muted TEXT on a dark slab use color.on-ink-secondary (8.00:1). Never on a light surface.
me.natemills.usage.decision: Contrast-gated to non-text use, the same gate color.text-muted-emphasis carries at ~3.7:1 (audit 2026-07-25 #14).

on-ink-border.$description: Hairline border on an always-dark slab (8% white).

on-ink-subtle.$description: Quiet near-white text on an always-dark slab (neutral.50), the softest step of the on-ink family, a hair below on-ink-emphasis. Theme-invariant, never on a light surface. Used for dark-section titles and muted hover text on inverse bands. Renamed from --color-neutral-subtle (2026-07-07; a surface-family name squatting on a text role).

static-white.$description: Theme-invariant white, never overridden per theme.

static-white-hover.$description: Hover step for static-white surfaces; theme-invariant light grey.

accent-emphasis.$description: Theme-aware emphasis text following the accent role: ink on light, lime on dark. For text on theme-following surfaces; on-* tokens are for fixed-colour surfaces. Renamed from --color-brand-emphasis (2026-07-02; one interactive role, accent).

dot-inactive.$description: Inactive carousel dot; .ds-dots is a specimen-only component today. Solid theme-aware grey: clears the SC 1.4.11 3:1 floor on light surfaces (the old rgba(127,127,127,0.45) composited to 1.67:1); dark themes override to neutral-500. Inverse bands restyle the carousel nav via --cn-rail-fill/--cn-rail-track, not this token.

me.natemills.usage.role: Inactive carousel dot; a solid theme-aware grey tuned for contrast.
me.natemills.usage.use: Inactive pagination dots on standard surfaces.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Do not substitute a translucent grey: the old rgba(127,127,127,0.45) was only 1.67:1. Inverse bands restyle the carousel nav via --cn-rail-fill/--cn-rail-track, not by re-scoping this token.
me.natemills.usage.decision: Tuned to clear the SC 1.4.11 3:1 non-text contrast floor.

dot-active.$description: Active carousel dot and position indicator; .ds-dots is a specimen-only component today. Follows the accent: ink on light, lime on dark (lime on the light page was 1.06:1, audit AX-01). Inverse bands restyle the carousel nav via --cn-rail-fill/--cn-rail-track (the default --cn-rail-fill reads this token).

me.natemills.usage.use: Large or decorative muted-emphasis text only.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Never on small body text: it composites to ~3.7:1 on light surfaces, below the 4.5:1 small-text floor.

text-muted-emphasis.$description: C-01 muted italic emphasis. 55% ink on light, flips to brand-lime on dark. Decorative and large-text use only: composites to ~3.7:1 on light surfaces, below the 4.5:1 small-text floor (audit TK-07). Renamed from --color-text-muted-em (2026-07-02; em read as the CSS unit).

on-ink-hover.$description: C-12 hover/focus tint on dark backgrounds.

overlay-soft.$description: Soft scrim behind floating chrome (35% black).

overlay-base.$description: Standard modal and lightbox scrim (62% black).

overlay-strong.$description: Heavy scrim for maximum content isolation (88% black).

display.$description: Display headings (h1, h2, h3) and large numbers.

mono.$value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: Tabular numbers, code, and eyebrow labels. Absorbed --font-mono-metric (2026-07-02): the metric alias had an identical stack; the IBM Plex Mono drift it once guarded against is documented in Section 4 history.

feature-mono.$description: OpenType slashed-zero feature for mono specimens.

xs.$description: 12px. Captions, footnotes, fine print; --text-caption resolves here.

sm.$description: 14px. Compact body: footer text, card bullets, dense UI copy.

lg.$description: 18px. Intro lines, award titles, component names.

2xl.$description: 32px. Small display headings; today only the type-scale specimen consumes it directly.

3xl.$description: 48px. The largest fixed stop; the fluid display clamps take over above it.

h1.$description: Page-level section headings (every section h2). The hero h1 is a documented exception with its own mobile-tuned clamp.

me.natemills.usage.role: The standard page-level section heading size (every section h2).
me.natemills.usage.use: Normal section headings across the page.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Do not use for the hero headline; the hero is a documented exception with its own mobile-tuned clamp (use display.hero).

h2.$description: Card titles, intro lines, sub-headings inside section bodies.

body.$description: Paragraphs, lists, default reading text, card body copy.

label.$description: Uppercase mono labels, eyebrows, stat labels, badges.

meta.$description: 13px meta tier, between caption (12px) and compact body (14px).

nav.$description: Header menu links; equals --text-label today, kept separate so nav can diverge.

hero.$description: The hero headline. Fluid 40 to 118px, the biggest type on the site.

me.natemills.usage.role: The hero headline size; the single biggest type on the site (40 to 118px).
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Do not use for ordinary section headings (use text.h1); it scales to 118px and will dwarf normal content.

section.$description: Oversized display headings; the Under-the-Hood section heads run on it.

intro.$description: Section intro lines and emphasis copy under a heading.

tight.$description: Display tracking. Pairs with every heading above card size.

weight.$description: The single weight every display preset carries (semibold). Display headings are always roman, never italic.

quote.$description: The testimonials’ giant serif quotation marks. Decorative punctuation, not data.

measure.$description: Line-length cap; 52ch Inter renders ~66 real chars.

sm.$description: Compact: dense cards, toolbars, filters. Clears the WCAG 2.5.8 AA 24px target minimum.

md.$description: Default. Most CTAs. Equals the base .btn height and meets the WCAG 2.5.5 AAA 44px touch target.

lg.$description: Hero CTAs and primary conversion actions.

pad-x.$description: Base button inline (left/right) padding. Component-level literal; sits off the 4px space scale by design (the historic DC-03 value, kept so the live button is unchanged).

me.natemills.usage.role: Base button inline (left/right) padding; an intentional off-scale literal.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Do not normalise it to a space.* token; 18px sits off the 4px scale by design so the live button stays unchanged.
me.natemills.usage.decision: Historic DC-03 value, kept deliberately off-scale.

pad-y.$description: Base button block (top/bottom) padding. Component-level literal, paired with --btn-pad-x.

me.natemills.usage.role: Base button block (top/bottom) padding; an intentional off-scale literal, paired with btn.pad-x.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Do not swap it for a space.* token; 10px is an intentional off-scale component literal.
me.natemills.usage.decision: Paired with the DC-03 off-scale btn.pad-x.

gap.$description: Space between a button's icon and its label.

font-size.$description: Button label size at the default (md) button.

font-weight.$description: Button label weight; semibold on every button.

glyph.$description: Lucide glyph size inside a default button.

glyph-sm.$description: Lucide glyph size inside a --sm button.

glyph-lg.$description: Lucide glyph size inside a --lg button.

transition.$value: background var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default), border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default), color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default), transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-default)
transition.$description: CSS composite: the button's hover/focus transition across its four animated properties. Reads var(--duration-fast)/var(--ease-default) directly so it follows a motion re-point (same pattern as --gradient; DTCG forbids embedded aliases inside string values).

primary-bg-hover.$description: Primary button fill on hover/focus (inverts to ink).

primary-fg-hover.$description: Primary button label on hover/focus (inverts to lime).

secondary-border.$description: Secondary button border (meets WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text contrast; matches icon-border).

icon-border.$description: Icon button border (meets WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text contrast).

control.$description: Visual size of the header brand cluster (avatar, icon buttons, wordmark height) on fine-pointer desktop. Visual only: every control keeps a --touch-target-min pointer target via a ghost hit area, gate-checked by touch-target-lint. Component-level literal between btn.sm and btn.md, chosen by eye against the 11px mono nav (header-refinements ruling 2026-07-11).

me.natemills.usage.role: Desktop-only visual size for the header brand cluster; a deliberate off-scale literal between btn.sm (32) and btn.md (44).
me.natemills.usage.use: Width and height of the header avatar and icon buttons, and the wordmark height, inside the fine-pointer desktop media scope, always paired with a 44px ghost hit area.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Never size a control's pointer target with it (targets stay --touch-target-min via ghosts), never on mobile or coarse-pointer widths, and never as a general small-button size (that is btn.sm).
me.natemills.usage.decision: Header-refinements review 2026-07-11: the 44px cluster overpowered the 11px mono nav; 36 visual with ghost targets won over on-scale 32 (too timid) and keep-44.

radius.$description: Card corner radius; the default for content cards and modals.

padding.$description: Card content inset; the standard 24px card padding.

border.$description: Card edge; 1px hairline that follows the theme border colour.

bg.$description: Card surface fill on light slabs.

dark-bg.$description: Card surface fill on dark slabs (.card--dark).

me.natemills.usage.role: Card surface fill specifically for cards on an always-dark slab (.card--dark).
me.natemills.usage.use: Only on cards sitting on an always-dark band.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Do not use as the default card surface (that is card.bg / color.surface), and do not theme-flip it.

dark-fg.$description: Card body text on dark slabs.

pad-x.$description: Chip inline (left/right) padding. Component-level literal; sits off the 4px space scale by design (between space-2 and space-3), kept so the live chip is unchanged.

gap.$description: Space between a chip's icon and its label.

icon-size.$description: Icon footprint inside a chip (Lucide stroke icon or normalised brand mark). Component-level literal.

line.$description: Chip label line height. Component-level literal, sized to the mono label; off the named line scale by design.

bg.$description: Chip fill at rest (and on active).

border-hover.$description: Chip border on hover and active.

gap.$description: Space between a badge's dot or icon and its label.

icon-size.$description: Leading icon footprint inside a badge (Lucide stroke icon). Component-level literal.

dot-size.$description: Status-dot diameter inside a badge. Component-level literal.

fg.$description: Badge label and icon colour; quiet by design, auto-flips per theme.

border.$description: Badge outline; hairline, auto-flips per theme.

dot.$description: Status-dot fill; brand lime in both themes (the dot is decorative, the label carries the meaning).

display.$description: Display-grade headings (--text-h1, section h2s). Big text wants the tightest leading.

heading.$description: Card titles and section sub-headings (--text-h2, UTH section heads).

title.$description: Smaller standalone titles (modal and tile titles).

snug.$description: Intro lines, award titles, compact meta text. A half-step tighter than body.

body.$description: Default reading text: paragraphs, lists, captions. The workhorse.

semibold.$description: 600. The workhorse emphasis: buttons, subheads, labels.

extrabold.$description: Five distinct weights; Inter is loaded at 400/500/600/700/800.

tight.$description: -0.02em. Tightens large text below display size.

normal.$description: 0. The body default; most text sits here.

wide.$description: 0.02em. Opens subheads a touch at mid sizes.

mono.$description: 0.01em. Tabular numbers and code; keeps digit columns steady.

1.$description: Hairline gap. Icon-to-label, tight inline spacing.

2.$description: Tight gap. Chip padding, small stacks.

4.$description: Base unit. Default gap between related elements; the compact card-padding tier (--card-pad-compact).

5.$description: Medium break. Group separation inside a section; the standard card-padding tier (--card-pad-standard).

6.$description: Large gap. Between subsections and card to card; the spacious card-padding tier (--card-pad-spacious).

7.$description: Block spacing between stacked content blocks.

8.$description: Major block separation and section inner padding.

9.$description: Section rhythm. The lower bound of vertical section padding (--section-padding).

10.$description: Section rhythm. The upper bound of vertical section padding (--section-padding).

11.$description: Outsized spacing for full-bleed editorial breaks.

12.$description: Largest step. Rare, marquee-scale vertical space.

compact.$description: Compact card-padding tier (16px). Dense content tiles: credential cards, health-check tiles, inner controls.

standard.$description: Standard card-padding tier (24px). The default content-card inset; matches the base .card. The standard, resolving the old 16-vs-24 doc conflict.

spacious.$description: Spacious card-padding tier (32px). Large feature, award, and full-testimonial cards (often the desktop step up from standard).

fast.$description: Hover, focus, and micro state feedback.

expressive.$description: Expressive tier: the slow, cinematic duration for a single large hero moment (the two-phone Spline scene scales in over this). Deliberately longer than the general-purpose slow tier and reserved for one large-surface entrance, never UI feedback. Collapsed to 1ms under reduced motion by the block in tokens/build.mjs.

default.$description: The workhorse symmetric curve. Begins and ends on screen.

entrance.$description: Decelerate, for elements entering the screen.

exit.$description: Accelerate, for elements leaving the screen.

emphasized.$description: Pronounced ease-out for overlay and menu entrance motion (items rising into view). A stronger, slower-settling decelerate than --ease-entrance.

linear.$description: Constant rate, no acceleration. For continuous loop motion: the hero ticker, both marquees, the glass column scroll, and the loading-icon cycles. Authored as a cubic-bezier twin of the linear keyword so it lives in the ease group with its siblings.

motion.$description: Scroll-reveal entrance geometry for the native scroll-driven .nm-sr pattern (animation-timeline: view()). The settle curve is {ease.emphasized}; the range/stagger are percentages of each element’s view() timeline. See design-system.md Section 7.

reveal-rise.$description: translateY start for the signature reveal (settles to 0).

reveal-shift.$description: translateX start that gives the signature reveal its diagonal.

reveal-scale.$description: start scale for the signature reveal (settles to 1).

reveal-slide.$description: translateX start for the slide-from-right reveal: featured + testimonial carousels and the design-system plate illustrations.

reveal-stagger.$description: per-item view()-range offset so grouped items deal out (animation-delay is ignored on scroll timelines).

none.$description: Square. No rounding, for sharp-cornered surfaces and full-bleed media.

sm.$description: Small radius. The workhorse for inputs, chips, and small controls.

md.$description: Medium radius. Mid-size controls and insets, a touch rounder than sm.

lg.$description: Large radius. The default for cards and modals.

xl.$description: Extra-large radius. Prominent panels and feature surfaces.

full.$description: Full round. Pills, tags, and circular buttons; forces a complete radius at any height.

hairline.$description: Default 1px hairline border; reads --color-border so it follows the theme. The standard card edge and divider.

strong.$description: Heavier 1px border; reads --color-border-strong. For edges that need to read past a hairline, such as interactive-card hover outlines. (Button borders moved to the btn.* component tokens in Task 87.)

me.natemills.usage.use: As the full focus-visible outline on interactive elements.
me.natemills.usage.doNotUse: Never delete it without providing a replacement focus style; it is the keyboard-focus indicator.

focus.$description: 2px focus outline; reads --color-focus-ring (ink on light, lime on dark). The keyboard-focus indicator, never removed without a replacement.

focus-ring-offset.$description: Offset between an element and its focus ring. Outsets the 2px ring so it clears the element edge.

wide.$description: Main content band. Stays proportional at 92vw (4% side gutters, matching the tablet/laptop feel) up to ~1826px viewport, then caps at 1680px so ultrawide layouts do not stretch without earning it (W38 ceiling kept, like the type and spacing scales). The old clamp(1440px,...) floor was removed: it froze the band at 1440px across the whole 1565-2181px range, so side margins ballooned to 240px on a 1920px screen (the 16-inch boxed-in bug, 2026-06-21).

bp.$description: Breakpoint reference values for documentation and audits only. CSS custom properties cannot be read inside media queries and no JS consumes these; the real breakpoints live in the media queries themselves, guarded by bp-lint.mjs.

touch-target-dot.$description: Carousel-dot hit area (WCAG 2.5.8 AA floor). Was consumed with an inline fallback but defined nowhere (audit TK-09).

base.$description: Base stacking level. The default flow; nothing is lifted.

dropdown.$description: Dropdowns, popovers, and menus that open over page content.

sticky.$description: Sticky and fixed chrome: the site header and pinned bars.

overlay.$description: Scrims and floating chrome above the sticky layer (backdrops, the floating action button).

modal.$description: Modal dialogs and lightboxes sitting above their scrim.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips and hover hints above modals.

toast.$description: Toasts and the scroll-progress bar: the top-most transient chrome. Wide 100-unit gaps leave room to insert a layer without renumbering.

skip-link.$description: Skip-to-content link on focus: the top-most element of all, so keyboard users can always reach it over any chrome.

none.$description: No shadow. The default; the system favours borders over shadows.

soft.$description: Subtle resting elevation, two stacked ink-alpha layers, for cards that lift just off the page. Dark mode swaps to deeper black-alpha.

lift.$description: Stronger elevation for overlays and float-on-scroll chrome only, not resting cards.

modal.$description: Modal and lightbox elevation. The deepest shadow, for surfaces floating above a scrim.

accent-period-shadow.$description: Depth under the lime period in section titles. Keeps the lime dot legible on light surfaces; resolves to none in dark, where lime already reads.

accent-dot-shadow.$description: Reserved depth for a lime indicator dot on light surfaces; no live consumer today; resolves to none in dark.

glass.$description: Liquid-frosted header glass (.m-liquidfrostlit). Light defaults here; dark overrides under darkTheme + osDark. The #lg-dist refraction (feDisplacementMap scale 100) is JS-injected and gated to desktop + hover.

tint.$description: Frosted fill colour, painted as the panel's padding-box layer. Near-white at 40% in light, ink at 50% in dark, so the bar tints whatever scrolls behind it toward the page substrate.

edge-top.$description: Top stop of the lit border gradient: a bright highlight along the top edge, as if light is catching the rim, giving the panel its 3D lift.

edge-bottom.$description: Bottom stop of the lit border gradient: near transparent, so the lit edge fades from top to bottom like a real bevel.

specular.$description: Inner top highlight, an inset box-shadow drawing the sharp specular line across the panel's top edge. A transparent no-op in dark, where the tint alone reads.

shadow.$description: Drop shadow that lifts the floating pill off the page once the header condenses on scroll. Tighter contact shadow plus soft ambient in dark.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur on the Chromium refraction path (desktop with a hover pointer), where it pairs with the #lg-dist displacement filter. 10px in light, 7px in dark.

blur-webkit.$description: Backdrop blur on the plain-frost fallback used everywhere without the displacement filter (Safari, iOS, mobile). 14px in light, 11px in dark.

saturate.$description: Backdrop saturation boost. Pumps the colour of whatever scrolls behind the bar so the frost reads as live glass, not a grey haze.

dim.$description: Backdrop brightness clamp at rest (1, no dimming). The Apple Liquid Glass trick: nudge the content behind the panel toward one substrate so nav text keeps AA contrast over anything. The scrolled value lives in glass.dim-scrolled.

dim-scrolled.$description: Backdrop brightness clamp once the header condenses into the floating pill. Light brightens the content behind it so dark nav text stays legible; dark darkens it to protect the near-white nav (see darkTheme).

color-dot-inactive.$description: Inactive dot on dark: brighter grey to clear 3:1 on the near-black page.

glass-specular.$description: Dark: no inner specular (transparent no-op so the box-shadow list stays valid). Tuned by Nathan 2026-06-04.

glass-shadow.$description: Dark: tight contact shadow plus soft ambient. Tuned 2026-06-04.

glass-dim-scrolled.$description: Scrolled backdrop dim, dark: near-neutral per Nathan's 2026-06-04 tuning (was 0.4). NOTE: the old 0.4 darkened content behind the floating pill to protect near-white nav contrast over light images; verify legibility over light content.

highContrast.$description: prefers-contrast: more overrides layered on light. Authored here so the token source owns every theme path (audit TK-03); build.mjs emits the media query. Every value is an existing primitive.

highContrastDark.$description: prefers-contrast: more overrides layered on dark (explicit toggle AND OS dark; build.mjs emits both scopes from this one group).
